title: Artificial intelligence-enhanced electrocardiography derived body mass index as a predictor of future cardiometabolic disease
summary: AI-ECG model predicts BMI from ECGs; the delta-BMI residual is associated with future cardiometabolic disease in BIDMC and UK Biobank cohorts after adjustment for measured BMI. The result is limited to this study and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
